info.name: ATOM - Franchise Onboarding
info.description:
Source-verified Postman Collection for Franchise Partner Onboarding.

Service: generic_onboarding_core_service
Server Port: 8085
Context-Path: /generic-onboarding/v1
Controller Base: /api/entities
Full Base URL: {{baseUrl}}/generic-onboarding/v1/api/entities

Strategy Bean: @Component("franchise") — resolved by OnboardingStrategyFactory via type.toLowerCase()
Entity Type: FRANCHISE
Subtypes (source-confirmed from FranchiseCompletenessValidator):
  PDA — vehicle track (requires ≥1 vehicle in data.vehicles before approval)
  RP  — vehicle track (requires ≥1 vehicle in data.vehicles before approval)
  BA  — facility track (requires ≥1 address before approval)
  BC  — facility track (requires ≥1 address before approval)

Authentication (GatewayUserContextFilter):
  Authenticated — all endpoints EXCEPT application-link token routes
    Required headers: x-user-id (UUID), x-company-id (UUID)
  Public — /api/entities/application/{token}/... routes are exempt from the filter

HTTP Status Codes (from GlobalExceptionHandler + controllers):
  200 OK  — all successful controller responses (ResponseEntity.ok(...))
  400 Bad Request — VALIDATION_ERROR, INVALID_ARGUMENT, BAD_REQUEST, missing headers
  404 Not Found  — ENTITY_NOT_FOUND, RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND
  409 Conflict   — DUPLICATE_ENTITY, INVALID_STATE_TRANSITION, CONFLICT
  502 Bad Gateway — EXTERNAL_SERVICE_ERROR (e.g. Approval Service unreachable)

All success responses use wrapper: { status: 'success', message: '...', data: {...}, timestamp: '...' }
All error responses use wrapper:   { status: 'error', code: '...', message: '...', details: '...', timestamp: '...', path: '...', requestId: '...' }
